summary: SKIPPER (formerly Tirtyl) is a Brisbane just-add-water cleaning and personal care brand founded in 2020. It sells through Shopify, Amazon and, since April 2026, 500+ Coles stores. In June 2026 it advertised its first finance hires with a brief to build systems and tap emerging tech; Tasman Forgie is listed as Finance Manager.

claims.text: skipper.org says Skipper was formerly known as Tirtyl and was founded in 2020 by May Bandi and Lachlan Hill.
claims.quote: Founded in 2020 by May Bandi and Lachlan Hill following a career break, Skipper (formerly known as Tirtyl)

claims.text: SKIPPER's LinkedIn company page gives Brisbane, Queensland as its headquarters and skipper.org as its homepage.
A SignalHire company profile (updated Sept 2026) lists Tasman Forgie as SKIPPER's Finance Manager.
SKIPPER announced on LinkedIn in April 2026 that its dish tab is on shelf in 500+ Coles stores nationwide.
claims.quote: Bringing the only Aussie-made dish tab to 500+ Coles stores nationwide.

claims.text: In June 2026 SKIPPER advertised its first hire in the Finance function, with a focus on tapping emerging tech.
claims.quote: Unique role as our first hire in the Finance function, with a focus on tapping emerging tech to elevate the traditional role of an in-house Accountant.

claims.text: Co-founder May Bandi described the first finance hire as building systems, owning management financials and leading commercial analysis.
claims.quote: Building systems, owning management financials and leading commercial analysis/strategic initiatives.

claims.text: May Bandi's June 2026 post said the Accountant (FinOps) role includes implementing better systems and processes and owning the relationship with SKIPPER's tax advisors.
claims.quote: strategic projects (implementing better systems & processes), owning the relationship with our tax advisors

claims.text: SKIPPER describes itself as a multi-channel e-commerce business across Shopify, Amazon and Coles, spanning Australia and the US.
claims.quote: We're a multi-channel e-commerce business (Shopify, Amazon, and a recent retail launch in Coles) spanning Australia and the US

hooks.text: Coles launch adds retailer remittances and deductions alongside Shopify and Amazon payouts, so the close just got more complex.
First finance hire was briefed to build systems and use emerging tech; Vert fits that remit.
Finance owns the relationship with tax advisors, so an audit trail on reconciliations matters.

risks.text: Tasman Forgie's role is confirmed only by a third-party directory (SignalHire, Sept 2026) and his LinkedIn profile could not be fetched; the Finance Manager role was still advertised in June 2026, so confirm he is current.
Finance team is brand new and may already be choosing systems; no tool stack for finance was found.

gaps: No finance-specific tech stack (Xero/MYOB/Link My Books etc.) found.
Tasman Forgie's LinkedIn profile could not be fetched, no posts by him found.
No podcast, Facebook or news coverage on finance operations found.
